blocks.text: LAKE SEBU, South Cotabato — Most households in this South Cotabato town typically serve tilapia grilled, fried, or cooked, but at this resort, the fish is served cold and creamy as ice cream. The unusual dessert gives one of Lake Sebu’s best-known products a new twist, turning a familiar food into something visitors may not expect to find on a menu. The idea may sound strange at first. After all, fish is hardly the first ingredient that comes to mind when ordering ice cream. But customers who have tried it say the dessert tastes much like an ordinary ice cream, without […]...
